description: A polished Flappy-style arcade challenge with real bird and pipe artwork, responsive input, sound, three distinct difficulty curves, and instant free-practice restarts. The wallet-backed reward route is intentionally hidden until Morpheus replay cadence and deployed settlement timing pass production validation.
description_zh: 精心打磨的飞鸟街机挑战，拥有真实小鸟与管道资源、灵敏操作、音效、三档不同难度曲线和即时重开的免费练习。钱包奖励路线将在 Morpheus 重放节奏与已部署结算计时通过生产验证后开放。
name: Flappy Dash

operation_panel.subtitle: Launch the arcade surface to choose a route and play. Free practice never opens a wallet prompt or writes to chain.
operation_panel.title: Flappy Dash

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: The deployed oracle wiring is reachable, but no wallet-funded oracle path is advertised until the empty reward pool is funded and the real input replay cadence completes an end-to-end settlement.

tee.description: Free practice is local and makes no TEE request. Morpheus replay remains a gated future lane until production validation is complete.
